verdict.rationale: Nothing in the evidence pack documents regional data-residency options or configurable data-retention controls for ComplyAdvantage Mesh. The closest items are adjacent and do not qualify: a 5-second TTL on export download URLs, optional API credential expiry, and case audit logs. None of these control where fraud data is stored or how long it is kept. As a compliance SaaS, this is a fair axis to judge, so the verdict is none rather than na.

support.subject: As an ops user, I can control where fraud data lives and how long it's kept — regional residency options and retention controls that survive a privacy review
